summary: Ansible does not enforce one password per vault ID label, so the same label can be used with different passwords, usually by mistake at a prompt; this can be fixed by rekeying one file.
questions: Does Ansible enforce that a vault ID always uses the same password?
I encrypted two files with the same vault ID but different passwords, how do I fix it?
Can one vault ID represent a class of passwords?

answer_card.title: Vault ID limitations
answer_card.answer_md:
Ansible does **not** enforce that a vault ID label always uses the same password. You can encrypt files with the same label but different passwords, usually by mistyping at a prompt (or deliberately, using a label as a class of passwords, in which case you must always know which one to use).

If it happened by accident, **rekey** one of the files to fix it.
